note: Curated Ahentic site-agent playbooks. Distilled for operators using abilities — not raw WordPress/agent-skills. Keep each playbook short; load via ahentic/get-wordpress-guidance.

playbooks.title: Plugin hygiene
playbooks.when_to_use: Installing, activating, deactivating, uninstalling, or choosing plugins; avoiding duplicates and reckless removals.

playbooks.title: Custom code and snippets
playbooks.when_to_use: Adding analytics, pixels, chat widgets, CSS/JS, or anything the user phrases as put in header/footer/functions.php.

playbooks.title: Pre-launch gaps
playbooks.when_to_use: Site not launched, missing pages, go-live checklist, what am I missing before launch.

playbooks.title: SEO decisioning
playbooks.when_to_use: Do I need an SEO plugin, recommend SEO, install Yoast/Rank Math/AIOSEO, search visibility.

playbooks.title: Safe cleanup
playbooks.when_to_use: Clean up WordPress, unused plugins, unused media, site feels cluttered or slow from cruft.

playbooks.title: Editor vs server content
playbooks.when_to_use: Create/edit pages or posts; unsure whether to use block editor tools or server create/update-post.

playbooks.title: Leave the canvas (move out of content)
playbooks.when_to_use: Promote or move something from the post body to featured image, excerpt, or another non-content destination.

playbooks.title: Wrap / group / columns via replace
playbooks.when_to_use: Group, wrap in columns, or unwrap blocks without a dedicated wrap ability.

playbooks.title: Web image fit
playbooks.when_to_use: Generating or placing images for posts/pages (featured, inline, hero) — pick aspect ratio and framing so images fit the web.

playbooks.title: Post title vs body headings
playbooks.when_to_use: Drafting or rewriting posts/pages/articles; choosing where the H1 goes; avoiding a duplicate title heading in the block tree.
